Presenting the official drama of Eagle Team’s “Dhoni Goriber Lorai/ ধনী গরিবের লড়াই নাটক” Script Written Sulyman Directed by Eagle Team. Produced by Kachi Ahmed.

ঈগল টিমের সব কন্টেন্ট দেখুন ঈগলওয়াচ অ্যাপে। Google Play Store থেকে এখনি ডাউনলোড করুন ঈগলওয়াচ অ্যাপ - https://tinyurl.com/eaglewatchapp

Summary of the story : Today's story is a serial drama called "Dhoni Goriber Lorai." The main plot revolves around the conflict between two families. One family is wealthy and holds a high social status in the village, while the other family is impoverished and considered to be of low social standing. Despite the societal divide, the educated son of the poor family captures the attention of the wealthy man's daughter, sparking the beginning of a dramatic family saga.

[Eagle Music Orginal Drama Series]
